title: lane r1: no fixture or criterion exercises the fix-scale falsifiers
description: Lane round 1. Lens: QE (F7) (validator: SE). Owner: SO session. Defect: two new falsification conditions ship with no corpus member and no acceptance-criterion coverage; the corpus promises a fixture per falsification condition — the new gates can silently regress like the layer-7 gate did pre-mechanization. Citations verified: contract:66, :83 vs :180 (unchanged), :170. Proposed: resolved-candidate (fix-lane fixture reproducing the mdatron shape; waived-bypass fixture; retrofit fixture; Gate coverage criterion extended).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: fix-lane fixture set added to the corpus (ungated-hotfix reproducing the mdatron shape, waived-bypass, retrofit, wrong-reason-failure) and the Red-gate cheat blocked criterion extended with fix-lane conduct exercising both falsifiers, the waiver pass, retrofit equivalence, and wrong-reason rejection.
